content: Zen Browser builds via @zen-browser/surfer, configured by a single repo-root surfer.json. Verbatim keys in zen-browser/desktop dev branch: name, vendor, appId, binaryName; version{product:firefox, version, candidate, candidateBuild}; buildOptions{generateBranding:true, windowsUseSymbolicLinks}; addons{} (per-addon source kinds github{id,repo,version,fileGlob} | amo{id,amoId,version} | url{id,url,version}); brands{release,twilight}{backgroundColor, brandShorterName, brandShortName, brandFullName, release{displayVersion, github.repo}, archives per platform}; license{licenseType(MPL-2.0|unknown), ignoredFiles regex}; updateHostname. Lineage: melon (Dot Browser) -> gluon (Pulse/Fushra, author stopped) -> surfer (Zen). Surfer still needs a src/ overlay tree and patches alongside surfer.json - it is not a single-file rebrand.
